maps.name: 新芽草甸
maps.scene: An open early-spring meadow under a pale mint-blue sky. Two broad, softly stepped green hill silhouettes recede into the distance. Sparse chunky grass and a few simple wildflower clusters frame only the extreme left and right edges. A continuous broad sage-green earth path spans the image, with a quiet open battle lane.
maps.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game-ready battle background candidate for an existing chibi pixel-art RPG
Input images: Image 1 and Image 2 are style references only; do not reproduce their cave or forest setting.
Primary request: Create one battle background for the beginner region 新芽草甸 (Sprout Meadow), matching the chunky low-density pixel-art environments in the references.
Scene/backdrop: A peaceful, open early-spring meadow under a pale mint-blue sky. Two broad, softly stepped green hill silhouettes recede into the distance. Sparse chunky grass and a few simple wildflower clusters frame only the extreme left and right edges.
Subject: The meadow landscape itself; no characters or props.
Style/medium: Coarse, friendly pixel-art RPG environment; large square pixels, broad stair-step contours, flat clean color clusters, roughly 16–20 muted colors with 2–3 shades per surface. Match the quiet, low-detail pixel scale of the references.
Composition/framing: Wide 16:9 side-view battlefield. Draw as though on a 160×94 logical canvas. A continuous broad, flat warm sage-green earth path spans the full width; ground line at 79% image height, floor continues to the bottom. Keep full-body spaces around x=24% and x=71% visually quiet and free of obstacles, with the center open for combat effects. Distant hills and any meadow details stay in the upper/background layers.
Lighting/mood: Gentle clear morning light, cheerful and calm, suitable for a level 1–15 beginner zone.
Color palette: Fresh but restrained sage and leaf greens, pale sky blue, soft warm cream flowers, muted earth.
Constraints: Opaque background only; no UI, text, labels, logos, border, watermark, characters, weapons, arena circle, spotlight, foreground plants covering the combat lane, tiny texture noise, dithering, granular detail, photorealism, painterly finish, high contrast, or objects at the actors' feet.
